item.description: ### Changed - **Usage bars stay fresh while you're away.** Claude's and Codex's 5-hour and weekly figures used to freeze at the last status-line render when no session was running, so coming back after hours showed old numbers under a "may be stale" label. Perch now refreshes them every 15 minutes while idle — only for a provider you've used on this Mac in the last week, and never while the Mac sleeps — using the same read-only login it already uses while you work.
